question: For each IPv4 subnet route, show the destination, next hop, subnet name and CIDR, and the allocation pool’s first and last IP (including the dense rank within each subnet as before). Also include, for each subnet, how many routes it has and the deviation of that subnet’s route count from the average route count across all IPv4 subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.id AS subnet_id,
    s.name AS subnet_name,
    s.cidr,
    r.destination,
    r.nexthop,
    p.first_ip,
    p.last_ip
  FROM subnets s
  JOIN subnetroutes r ON r.subnet_id = s.id
  LEFT JOIN ipallocationpools p ON p.subnet_id = s.id
  WHERE s.ip_version = 4
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.subnet_id ORDER BY b.destination) AS dense_rank
  FROM base b
),
subnet_counts AS (
  SELECT
    subnet_id,
    COUNT(*) AS route_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY subnet_id
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(route_count) AS avg_route_count
  FROM subnet_counts
)
SELECT
  r.destination,
  r.nexthop,
  r.subnet_name,
  r.cidr,
  r.first_ip,
  r.last_ip,
  r.dense_rank,
  c.route_count,
  c.route_count - a.avg_route_count AS deviation
FROM ranked r
JOIN subnet_counts c ON c.subnet_id = r.subnet_id
CROSS JOIN avg_count a
ORDER BY r.subnet_id, r.dense_rank, r.destination
